## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry beach cover-up
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops
- Hoodie or light jacket for cooler evenings
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Shorts and skirts for beach days
- Sun hat or visor

### Toiletries
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+ or higher)
- Lip balm with SPF
- Beach towel
- Reusable water bottle
- Biodegradable sunscreen or reef-safe products
- Travel-sized shampoo and conditioner
- Toiletries bag or container
- Dental kit

### Electronics & Accessories
- Smartphone and portable charger
- Travel-sized power bank
- Headphones or earbuds
- Travel adapter for US outlets
- Camera or GoPro (optional)
- Waterproof phone case
- Travel-sized sunglasses

### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, insurance)
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel-sized first-aid kit
- Travel-sized toiletries (toothpaste, toothbrush, etc.)
- Beach umbrella or parasol
- Sunscreen for kids or sensitive skin
- Extra batteries or charging cables
- Travel-sized laundry bag
- Travel-sized snacks or energy bars
- Travel-sized water bottle
- Travel-sized towel
- Travel-sized beach bag
- Travel-sized beach umbrella
- Travel-sized sunscreen
- Travel-sized beach towel
